summary: On successful skeleton-key use against a trapped floor chest, lock.c:picklock toggles olocked, marks lknown, then invokes trap.c:chest_trap before exercise and resetting the occupation. JS refuses the trapped-box arm before those source-ordered state changes. Port the whole picklock occupation callback and preserve its magic-key and trapped-door branches; chest_trap is an active shared dependency.

source.branch: picklock occupation: the chest remains on the hero square, rn2(100) succeeds, no magic key is used, xlock.box is trapped, and source toggles lock/knowledge before invoking chest_trap(FINGER,FALSE).
callers: lock.c:pick_lock sets the xlock context and starts the picklock occupation
js/lock.js:pick_lock establishes xlock and dispatches js/lock.js:picklock each occupied turn
dependencies: trap.c:chest_trap is partially ported in js/trap.js and currently reserved by A45 for shield display wiring; coordinate after that delivery
lock.c:picklock magic-key and trapped-door arms are also unported; return-valued helper calls in those arms must be source-backed

evidence: C lock.c:68-160 validates the box or door position, advances usedtime, rolls rn2(100), handles the magic key, prints success, toggles box->olocked, sets lknown, calls chest_trap when otrapped, then exercises Dexterity and clears usedtime.

JS js/lock.js:484-558 reaches UnsupportedLockError at trapped box before toggling olocked or lknown, before chest_trap, and before exercise. Its magic-key and trapped-door branches also refuse. This is a partial whole-function port, not a case-specific message fix.

The independent v12 case first stops at zero-based step 52 with 52 of 53 screens and all 3023 RNG calls matched in challenges/evaluations/20260929033350-v12.json; the remaining screen is the trapped-chest occupation continuation.

C trap.c:6294-6501 owns chest_trap, which this lock.c function calls with a discarded result. A45 currently owns only its shield-display caller wiring; the picklock task must coordinate production behavior without overwriting A45 changes.
